text:
lina: Heads-up — trying to onboard a partner on the JS SDK using Deno/Bun and hit several small DX barriers that add up. Wanted to capture here and coordinate fixes.
omar: quick list please?
lina: 1) README default shows `import Redwood from 'redwood'` which fails in Deno: `Uncaught Error: package.json exports do not contain ./deno` and tsc complains about no default export. 2) Bun (older builds) sometimes lacks `crypto.subtle` so auth signing throws. 3) fetch/stream differences in Bun/edge cause our body parser to crash. 4) retry behavior can double-send non-idempotent requests on stream errors.
trent: thanks. For (1) we should publish an explicit deno entry and update examples. Deno folks expect either a `redwood/deno` path or a clear ESM named export.
maria: agreed. I patched the README in a local branch and added `examples/deno-quickstart` with deno.json + import_map.json. Example snippet: ```ts
// examples/deno-quickstart/main.ts
import { Redwood } from 'redwood/deno';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: Deno.env.get('REDWOOD_KEY') });
```
omar: nice. For package.json exports we can do conditional exports like: "./deno": "./dist/deno/index.mjs" plus the normal import/require mappings so node users keep the cjs/esm behavior.
trent: typings: Deno sometimes needs explicit .d.ts next to the deno bundle. Publish `dist/deno/index.d.ts` and ensure export paths include a types entry or `typesVersions` so TS picks it up.
lina: on (2) webcrypto: propose a tiny runtime shim that does `const subtle = globalThis.crypto?.subtle ?? (await import('./shims/subtle-fallback.js')).subtle` so we only load the fallback when needed. Keep shim dynamic so bundles remain small.
omar: good. For (3) response body parsing in Bun/edge: avoid `instanceof ReadableStream` checks; instead attempt `await response.json()` then `await response.arrayBuffer()` and only fallback to stream reads as last resort. That covers weird stream shapes.
trent: (4) retries: our SDK retries on what we treat as network errors. Some runtimes surface body streaming errors after headers (so server may have received it). We should: a) not auto-retry non-idempotent endpoints; b) support sending an `Idempotency-Key` header in sample apps and recommend it in docs; c) add a safer retry policy that avoids full re-send if the server indicates receipt.
maria: I'll add a small `runtime-adapters` module (isDeno/isBun/isNode + fetchNormalize + subtleShim) and unit tests that mock Bun missing subtle and weird response bodies. Will try to make everything tree-shakeable.
lina: CI change: add a samples matrix job that runs node 18/20, deno 1.34+/1.35, bun nightly on the sample apps so regressions get caught early. ci-bot: nightly samples pipeline failed: https://ci.internal/infra/deno-samples/1342 (shows exports/deno resolve error)
omar: I can change package.json exports and publish a patch build. Example exports snippet we can use: `{"exports": {"./deno": "./dist/deno/index.mjs", ".": {"import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"}}}`
trent: remember to add `types` for deno entry: "types": "dist/deno/index.d.ts" or use path exports to point to `.d.ts`. Also update the monorepo publishing script to include the deno bundle.
maria: I'll open two PRs: one that adds the runtime-adapters + subtle shim + fetch normalizer and tests, and a second that updates package.json exports + examples/deno-quickstart + README.
lina: I'll add a troubleshooting blurb to the SDK README: "If you see \"exports do not contain ./deno\", try `import { Redwood } from 'redwood/deno'` or upgrade to SDK >= x.y.z". Also add a note about idempotency keys for safe retries.
omar: let's also include a small Bun note: some Bun versions have `globalThis.crypto` but not `.subtle` — call out supported Bun versions in README and the minimal polyfill approach.
trent: CI: once PRs land add deno/bun to the sample matrix. ci-bot: created issue #987: "SDK: Deno/Bun compatibility & safe retries — deno entry, runtime adapters, webcrypto shim, fetch normalization, idempotency policy" assigned to maria,omar.
maria: linking PRs here when ready. aiming to get a patch out before partner demo tomorrow.
lina: thanks everyone — this should significantly reduce onboarding friction for partners using edge runtimes and make our retry behavior safer. :thumbsup:
